meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML. Use this whenever the user wants WeChat article formatting, article preview, WeChat draft upload, image generation for articles, cover or infographic generation, image-post creation, writer-style drafting, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or current discovery of supported providers, themes, prompts, and layout modules.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Markdown 转成可直接发布的公众号图文
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常写公众号文章,想跳过手动排版和上传。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown into a WeChat article ready to publish.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write WeChat articles and want to skip manual formatting and uploading.

howto.what: 把 Markdown 文章转成微信公众号排版 HTML，并可按需做预览、发布前检查、封面/信息图/图片帖生成、标题建议与文风改写；上传草稿等发布动作只在明确要求时才执行。
howto.when: 当你说要排微信文章、做文章预览、生成封面或上传草稿，或想了解当前支持的主题/供应商时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 排成微信公众号的 HTML，先不要上传。
say.note: 只做转换，生成排版文件。

say.text: 给这篇文章生成一张封面图。
根据内容建议几个更抓人的微信标题。
say.note: 给出候选标题，不会直接发布。

howto.what_en: Converts Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, and can preview, check readiness, generate covers/infographics/image-posts, suggest titles, or rewrite style on request. Publishing side effects such as upload or draft creation happen only when explicitly asked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for WeChat article formatting, preview, cover generation, draft upload, or a discovery of currently supported themes/providers.

say_en.text: Format this Markdown as WeChat HTML; don't upload yet.
Generate a cover image for this article.
Suggest some catchy WeChat titles for this content.
